arguments.sql:
SELECT
    (SELECT COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT player_api_id) FROM Player) AS non_unique_or_null_player_ids,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Player WHERE height IS NOT NULL AND typeof(height) NOT IN ('integer', 'real')) AS nonnumeric_heights,
    COUNT(*) AS attribute_rows,
    COUNT(pa.heading_accuracy) AS recorded_heading_rows,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN pa.heading_accuracy IS NOT NULL AND typeof(pa.heading_accuracy) NOT IN ('integer', 'real') THEN 1 END) AS nonnumeric_heading_rows,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN p.player_api_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS matched_attribute_rows
FROM Player_Attributes AS pa
LEFT JOIN Player AS p ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id;

arguments.sql:
SELECT
    p.player_name,
    AVG(pa.heading_accuracy) AS mean_heading_accuracy
FROM Player AS p
JOIN Player_Attributes AS pa ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE p.height > 180
  AND pa.heading_accuracy IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY p.player_api_id, p.player_name
ORDER BY mean_heading_accuracy DESC, p.player_api_id ASC
LIMIT 10
